title: Positive symmetrizers and non-Hermitian evolution
source_policy: Independent exposition, complete programme proofs and exact scholarly references.

source_references.title: Lars Hörmander — The Analysis of Linear Partial Differential Operators III (reprint of 1994 edition)
source_references.reading_scope: Both complete current page extracts read and page images inspected: scalar first-order hypotheses and the beginning of Lemma 23.1.1 energy proof. This is context, not a claimed external variable-metric system proof.

changes: Reconnected the complete current BR, SY, EC, K and integration proofs.
Made every uniform time-symbol derivative explicit in the metric and projector-to-metric hypotheses.
Proved both binomial recurrences, positive root identities and absolutely convergent scalar products.
Proved the Hilbert norm-square rule for integrably differentiated paths and its time-dependent operator product rule.
Proved oriented extra-order operator-norm Taylor estimates for the actual variable-metric evolution and all smoothing differentiation majorants.
Retained every original display and all five complete original solutions.
